problem_observed: The previous implementation embedded Monaco and added platform templates, but did not yet provide a full desktop code workbench.
The file list came from a static snapshot rather than a runtime workspace scan.
There was no tab strip, command toolbar, Monaco diff review, or editor settings popup.
accepted_decisions: Keep Monaco as the editing engine but make workbench behavior platform-owned.
Add `list_workspace_text_files` in Rust rather than giving the browser arbitrary filesystem access.
Add open editor tabs, command toolbar, diff mode, and settings popup in Source Review.
Keep protected path and workspace escape rules in the Tauri backend.
rejected_options: Clone or embed the whole VS Code app for this slice.
Continue using only a static source snapshot for the desktop editor.
Expose direct browser filesystem write access.
validation_gate: Rust check, Workspace Monitor check/test/build/customer/perf, Desktop readiness/test, and Browser smoke must pass.
